description: Gate 12 (exec-policy Decision::Forbidden-on-Never), x86_64 port of patch 13. In render_decision_for_unmatched_command() the code compares the AskForApproval discriminant (cmp edx, 3) and does `jne <error>` to the Forbidden error-emit block, which loads the 63-char string 'approval required by policy, but AskForApproval is set to Never' (mov esi, 0x3f; lea r15, [rip+anchor]) and builds the error. NOP-ing the jne makes execution always fall through to the allow/continue path, so Forbidden is never taken under AskForApproval::Never. Length-preserving: jne rel32 (0f 85 28 01 00 00, 6 bytes) -> 6-byte NOP (66 0f 1f 44 00 00). Verified on 0.139.0: bytes match at the computed offset and the patched binary still launches (codex --version).

patches.match_disasm: jne 0x144fbc37c  (branch to Forbidden error-emit block when discriminant != 3)
patches.replace_disasm: nop (6-byte)  — fall through to the allow/continue path
